name: Text-to-Image (DeepFashion-MultiModal) Benchmark
description: This work presents an open-source unified benchmarking and evaluation framework for text-to-image generation models, with a particular focus on the impact of metadata augmented prompts. Leveraging the DeepFashion-MultiModal dataset, we assess generated outputs through a comprehensive set of quantitative metrics, including Weighted Score, CLIP (Contrastive Language Image Pre-training)-based similarity, LPIPS (Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity), FID (Frechet Inception Distance), and retrieval-based measures, as well as qualitative analysis. Our results demonstrate that structured metadata enrichments greatly enhance visual realism, semantic fidelity, and model robustness across diverse text-to-image architectures. While not a traditional recommender system, our framework enables task-specific recommendations for model selection and prompt design based on evaluation metrics.
evaluation_method: composite_score (weighted combination of CLIP similarity, LPIPS, FID, retrieval metrics and other quality measures)
general_score_metric: Weighted Score (composite of CLIP, LPIPS, FID, and retrieval-based metrics)
reputation: A focused, domain-specific benchmark valued in fashion and multimodal research for studying metadata-augmented prompts, but not yet a broadly adopted general benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-centric benchmark with domain-specific biases (fashion styles); metrics (FID, LPIPS, CLIP) can be sensitive to model/generation settings. Potential dataset/style contamination and limited domain coverage; results can be sensitive to prompt engineering and evaluation weighting.
